meta.title: WhatsApp invitations for Saudi celebrations
meta.description: Design a beautiful invitation, send it on WhatsApp, collect RSVPs and check guests in with QR codes. Weddings, engagements and events in Riyadh and Jeddah.

hero.title: Invite every guest where they already are: WhatsApp.
hero.subtitle: Choose a beautiful card, upload your guest list, and we send the invitation, collect confirmations, remind guests and check them in at the door.
hero.trust: No app to install. Guests reply in one tap.
hero.bubbleBody: Mohammed & Noura invite you to their wedding on Thursday. Will you join us?

how.title: From idea to full house in three steps
how.lead: No design skills, no chasing replies, no paper lists at the door.

one.title: Design your invitation
one.body: Add your event details, pick a card and make it yours with your names, colors and language.

two.title: Upload your guests
two.body: Import a CSV or Excel list. We check every Saudi number and send the invitation on WhatsApp.

three.title: Confirm and welcome
three.body: Guests confirm in WhatsApp and receive a personal QR code. Your team scans it at the entrance.

whatsapp.title: Sent on WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: Your invitation arrives in the app your guests open every day, so it gets seen.

rsvp.title: Live RSVP tracking
rsvp.body: See who was sent, delivered, confirmed, declined or is still pending, in real time.

qr.title: QR check-in
qr.body: Each confirmed guest gets a unique code. Staff scan with a phone and see valid or already used instantly.

reminders.title: Automatic reminders
reminders.body: Gentle reminders go out one week and one day before the event, with no effort from you.

bilingual.title: Arabic and English
bilingual.body: Write your invitation in Arabic, English or both, with proper right-to-left typography.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.body: Built around the Saudi PDPL: guest consent, easy opt-out, and export or deletion of your data.

occasions.title: A card for every occasion
occasions.lead: Elegant static cards, animated invitations and video invites with music.

planners.title: Run every client's event from one place
planners.lead: Built for wedding and event planners who manage many celebrations at once.

multi.title: Multiple events
multi.body: Manage dozens of live events with one dashboard and one view of every guest list.

team.title: Team access
team.body: Invite coordinators and entrance staff with the right permissions for each role.

clients.title: Client sub-accounts
clients.body: Keep each client's events, guests and invoices neatly separated.

brand.title: Your standards
brand.body: Reuse customized templates and guest lists across clients and seasons.

pricing.title: Simple, honest pricing
pricing.lead: A flat fee per event plus a small amount per guest. Pay once, no subscription.
pricing.footnote: Prices in Saudi riyals. VAT is added at checkout.

whatsapp.q: Do my guests need to install anything?
whatsapp.a: No. Guests receive the invitation in WhatsApp and reply with one tap.

guests.q: What guest list formats can I upload?
guests.a: CSV or Excel files. We validate Saudi mobile numbers (+966) and tell you about any that need fixing before sending.

qr.a: Confirmed guests receive a personal QR code. Your staff open the check-in page on a phone, scan, and instantly see if it is valid or already used.

reminders.a: Yes. Guests who have not declined receive a reminder one week and one day before your event.

privacy.q: How do you handle guests' phone numbers?
privacy.a: You confirm you have permission to contact your guests, every message includes an opt-out, and you can export or delete guest data at any time.

planners.q: Can I manage events for my clients?
planners.a: Yes. Planner accounts support multiple events, team members and client sub-accounts.

finalCta.title: Your guests are one message away
finalCta.lead: Create your invitation in minutes and let us handle the rest.

footer.tagline: WhatsApp-native invitations for weddings and celebrations.
